summary: Azoth failed to surface the major strategic pivot from rushed v0.2.0 release stabilization toward a distributed personal-control-plane knowledge system. The live operator surfaces kept pointing at stale hydration/delivery language instead of showing that the Batch 0/T-045 arc was closed and that the next move needed context recovery plus a fresh scoped continuation.

recommended_action: Treat completed initiative-bank arcs as a first-class context state. When all candidate slices are hydrated/complete and no open candidate remains, dashboards and /next surfaces must show context-recovery/continuation language, name the strategic anchors, and require a fresh scope before more hydration, delivery, release, source onboarding, or personal-root mutation. residual_risk: This repair makes the current failure visible and guards the known recurrence path, but future initiative banks still need richer lifecycle-state modeling if they begin spanning multiple independent strategic arcs.
